coverage_gaps: No systematic matching evidence found for the new full encoding, imputation, reduction and nested-ensemble grids. This does not prove no prior attempt exists.

v4.caveat: Feature, tree-count and blend selection reuse training labels. Validation results contain selection optimism and do not guarantee leaderboard scores.

paired_bootstrap.caveat: Paired row bootstrap of fixed OOF predictions; it does not correct selection optimism or certify a leaderboard gain.

v5.caveat: Features, model variants and weights reuse training labels. Validation contains selection optimism; leaderboard observations are recorded separately with their source.

recipe.promotion_rule: Pooled KS and mean-fold KS must improve, with at least six of ten fold wins.
recipe.selection_status: Exploratory confirmation. Three-fold pooled and mean KS improved slightly; only one of three fold scores improved.

paired_bootstrap.caveat: Fixed OOF predictions; conditional on selected features/models/weights. Does not remove selection optimism.

public_leaderboard_result.note: Score reported by user for version 5; actual upload timestamp is not known. The local prediction file and reported score are associated by conversation context.
public_leaderboard_result.reference_status: Best recorded public checkpoint; previously verified through Kaggle API.

selection_3fold.caveat: Small exploratory improvement; only one fold improved.

node380_kumo.verification: Independently recomputed from 70,000 saved OOF rows during planning; held submission only.
